svg.title: Kritva Nexus external interface view (preliminary planning diagram)
svg.desc: The planned Kritva Nexus SoC as one box with its external interfaces: DDR4, Octal SPI PSRAM, OSPI NOR boot, two Ethernet RGMII ports, four camera inputs, parallel DPI display, peripheral I/O counts, clock, reset and power, critical fault inputs, debug and always-on wake sources. Each interface carries its register label.
svg.text: Two Ethernet ports to external PHYs
PRELIMINARY PLANNING DIAGRAM, NOT A PRODUCT SPECIFICATION.
Derived from the requirements register and interface register; every label is the register label. Targets are not achieved results. INT-nnn means NX-INT-nnn.
